if value['info']['triggerTypeId'] is None: return False
	
	triggerTypeName = value['triggerTypeName']
	if triggerTypeName == 'Mode Change': return True 		#don't need anything else
	elif triggerTypeName == 'Product Change':	return True
	if triggerTypeName == 'Shift Change': return True
	if triggerTypeName == 'Timed Interval': return (self.view.custom.info.intervalMins or 0) > 0
	if triggerTypeName == 'Recurring': return bool(value['info']['rruleStr']) and system.kanoa.schedule.validateRrule(value['info']['rruleStr'])['valid']
	if triggerTypeName == 'State Change': return len(value['info']['stateIds'] or []) > 0
	if triggerTypeName == 'General Count': return (value['info']['productionCount'] or 0) > 0 and bool((value['info']['counterName'] or '').strip())
	elif 'Count' in triggerTypeName: return (self.view.custom.info.productionCount or 0) > 0
	
	return True
return str(value)

customMethods.name: saveData
customMethods.script:
userId = system.kanoa.security.getIDPUserId(self.session.props.auth.user)
	triggerInfo = dict(self.view.custom.info)
	chkShtTriggerId = self.view.custom.info.chkShtTriggerId
	
	if chkShtTriggerId is None: 
		chkShtTriggerId = system.kanoa.quality.config.addChkShtTrigger(triggerInfo, userId)
		self.view.params.values.chkShtTriggerId = chkShtTriggerId
		retVal = 1 if (chkShtTriggerId or None) is not None else 0
		triggerTypeName = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('triggerTypeName', system.kanoa.quality.config.getChkShtTriggers({'chkShtTriggerId': chkShtTriggerId}))
		change = "Trigger %s added"%triggerTypeName
	else: 
		retVal = system.kanoa.quality.config.updateChkShtTrigger(triggerInfo, userId)
		change = "Trigger %s modified"%triggerInfo['triggerTypeName']
		self.view.refreshBinding("custom.info")
	
	if self.view.custom.triggerTypeName == 'Recurring' and triggerInfo.get('rruleStr'):
		ruleText = system.kanoa.schedule.convertRecurringRuleToText(triggerInfo['rruleStr'])
		change += ": %s" % (ruleText if ruleText and 'License Expired' not in ruleText else triggerInfo['rruleStr'])

	if system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('chkShtVersionStateName', system.kanoa.quality.sheet.getSheets({'chkShtId': self.view.custom.info.chkShtId})) != 'Draft': 
		system.kanoa.quality.sheet.addChangeLog({'chkShtId': self.view.custom.info.chkShtId, 'change': change}, userId)
		
	system.perspective.sendMessage('changeLogUpdated', {})
	
	return retVal
